items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Roselle said today that he was very pleased with the way New Orleans has handled it

ctx.x: You know, we had a couple of the places that just moved back a few feet, like not any smallest restaurants in the world. But we don't see as much of the corn cobs or the stuff on the street. I know. I think it looks a lot cleaner. The street looks a lot cleaner than me. Doesn't it? Do you, Pete? I think they're going to have to if they want to keep the conventions down here or the Super Bowl again. That would be great if we could get the Super Bowl every year. Well, the way... That would be fantastic.
Roselle said today that he was very pleased with the way New Orleans has handled it and that we'll be in strong consideration for next year. I think it's going to be tough for Miami to get it back.
I think so, too. I think the governor of Florida made a statement, too, that he said that they already missed the boat. The Floridians missed the boat.
